t: The sign that Allah wants good for someone
a: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ، وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ وَاللَّهُ يُعْطِي
p: Man yuridi-Llāhu bihi khayran yufaqqihhu fi-d-dīn, wa innamā anā qāsimun wa-Llāhu yuʿṭī
m: Whoever Allah wants good for, He gives him understanding in the religion. I am only one who distributes, and Allah is the one who gives.
